description: saleos is an integrated assessment model for environmental, service-capacity and financial impacts of low-Earth-orbit broadband constellations. Its README names Kuiper, OneWeb and Starlink scenarios and links a research paper, with code to estimate emissions, broadband capacity and social costs. Users specify constellation and demand assumptions; outputs are comparative network-service and impact estimates for global or regional coverage. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the code; provider fleet and launch data may have separate sources and dates. A limitation is that planned spacecraft and launch schedules can change quickly, and a modelled coverage or cost is not verified operator service. The model can compare satellite-network expansion and dependency scenarios. The related NS-3 catalogue platform is a communication-network simulator, while saleos addresses constellation-scale sustainability, not packet events. No satellite ephemeris or model run was downloaded.
inputs: Constellation fleet, capacity, cost and emissions assumptions
name: saleos LEO constellation sustainability model
notes: G7 G7-2043. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outputs: Broadband capacity, emissions and cost estimates
